game_title: Dam Filler – Ore Vein Depths Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths, a rich ore vein: the cave miner must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Dam Filler: Raise the water level in a loop while level < max, without overflowing.
theme: Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths: a rich ore vein
core_gameplay_loop: In Ore Vein Depths, repeat each round: Raise the water level in a loop while level < max, without overflowing. Each round, a new torches challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the level value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 230 points of torches by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 230, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Dam Filler
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Dam Filler' (Week 4 slot 8), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Ore Vein Depths'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how level changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wraiths in Ore Vein Depths.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 230 within 29 seconds.
